acceptance.rule: OWNER 2026-10-08: TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0; SS sensitivity (60/25 uncertainties; +15 design target), agreed die-clock IO budgets, DRC 0

job_spec.name: qfd_cdc1024_a-1a9caff1a-tc
job_spec.purpose: redesign-qwen 2026-10-10 (coordinator: qfd_io_xfifo): one hardened 1,024-b single-crossing CDC tile (x 4) in place of the five-channel four-clock io_xfifo (FF -88.7 / R2O -331). Variant a.

calibrate.reason: Qwen die masters reference IO in-run to the block's own propagated clock (io_ref_skew.sdc), i.e. this variant's own insertion; no budget sheet

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.010 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/qwen_die_masters/signoff/qfd_cdc1024_a.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 OT_PIN_BALANCE_H='M4 M6' OT_PIN_BALANCE_V='M5 M7' PIN_H='M4 M6' PIN_V='M5 M7' bash physical/qwen_die_masters/jobs/route_master.sh qfd_cdc1024_a {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_link_rx128 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_link_rx128 --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

hold_eco.reason: post-route mm hold ECO (REDESIGN_RULES: keep it on)
